name: pdfcraft-mcp-server
description: MCP server for PdfCraft: read, split, merge, organize, watermark, protect, redact, fill, sign, convert, compress and OCR PDFs with PdfCraft's own engine, from Claude (Windows, macOS, Linux).

scripts.pack:mcpb: npm run build && npx -y @anthropic-ai/mcpb pack . pdfcraft-mcp-server.mcpb

author: Jhon Supelano (https://github.com/jhonsu01)

codex.shortDescription: Merge, split, OCR, sign and convert PDFs with your local PdfCraft
defaultPrompt: Merge these PDFs and add page numbers
Make this scanned PDF searchable with OCR
Convert this PDF to Word and reduce its file size
